# Live Orbit

Live Orbit is an iPhone app from Apps Made Better LLC, an independent app publisher based in Texas. Founder Samuele Marcucci lives in New York City.

Explore satellites around Earth, visible pass predictions, Sky Mode and AR guidance, public radio recordings, search, and space news. Satellite positions and passes are estimates based on orbital data. The app is free to download with in-app purchases.
